title: Benchmark atlas
provenance: Manually reviewed official sources; no live scrape, model execution or universal SOTA claim.

benchmarks.name: FastBench
benchmarks.existing: Incremental video, timed answers and ProactiveFrame adaptive FPS.
benchmarks.gamst: Compare lightweight triggers and periodic audits at matched context budgets.
benchmarks.prepare: Preserve MP4 FPS and clip timestamps; pin annotation, judge and official preset.
benchmarks.limitations: Video time is not wall-clock inference latency. Annotated focus times are oracle-only. Code MIT does not license the videos.

results.scope: Manuscript adaptive-frame preset; not reproduced here.

benchmarks.name: SPOT-Bench
benchmarks.problem: When to respond / when to stay silent
benchmarks.existing: Timeliness-F1 scores every prediction across the stream.
benchmarks.gamst: Measure missed events, duplicate alerts and unnecessary consumer calls.
benchmarks.prepare: Request source Ego4D/Ego-Exo4D access and accept HF conditions; start with full Detection release.
benchmarks.limitations: Visual-only, audio removed. Interaction/Intervention release is validation-only. CC BY-NC-SA and source conditions apply.

benchmarks.name: OVO-Bench
benchmarks.problem: Current state / past evidence / future response
benchmarks.existing: Real-time perception, backward tracing and forward active responding.
benchmarks.gamst: Test context retention, current versus last-seen state and causal delivery.
benchmarks.prepare: Use ~44 GB source archive plus official chunker, or ~144 GB pre-chunked archives; pin release.
benchmarks.limitations: Published and revised code protocols differ. CC BY-NC-SA and source licenses apply. No verified score imported in this catalog.

benchmarks.name: StreamingBench
benchmarks.existing: 18 tasks with questions at multiple video timestamps.
benchmarks.gamst: Check that cheaper context does not degrade general understanding.
benchmarks.prepare: Download official videos and QA on GCP; reconcile actual revision counts before freezing.
benchmarks.limitations: Posted results mostly use older model versions and different frame budgets; not a current universal SOTA.

results.scope: Official site historical overall table; video input.
Official site historical overall table; 60 frames.

benchmarks.name: OmniPro
benchmarks.existing: Probe tests pre/post event understanding; Online tests timing and content jointly.
benchmarks.gamst: Compare audio-only, vision-only and fused context; retain non-speech evidence.
benchmarks.prepare: Keep raw video/audio and trigger labels; implement a persistent begin/observe/end adapter.
benchmarks.limitations: 84% audio dependency. Probe and Online are distinct leaderboards. Preserve official matching tolerance and judge.

results.scope: Paper Table 2; prompted pre/post evaluation, not Online.

benchmarks.name: StreamArena
benchmarks.problem: Long-term memory / agent use of evidence
benchmarks.existing: Continuous QA, historical recall, tool use and proactive responses.
benchmarks.gamst: Evaluate whether an unchanged consumer benefits from bounded Gamst memory.
benchmarks.prepare: Keep question.en.jsonl, video archives and timestamps; separate published trajectories from test inputs.
benchmarks.limitations: Mixed is a multi-model system, not a matched-cost single backbone. Annotation CC BY-NC; video source rights apply.

results.scope: Online multi-model system; not matched to our hardware.
Same published v2 run; separate capability.
Same published v2 run; separate capability.
Same published v2 run; separate capability.

benchmarks.name: Inf-Streams-Eval
benchmarks.existing: Long videos with dense per-second frame/text alignment.
benchmarks.gamst: Measure quality over time plus process/server/GPU memory, drops and latency.
benchmarks.prepare: Use the Eval dataset and official scorer; do not substitute training data or repeated short clips.
benchmarks.limitations: Win rate is not accuracy; 8 FPS throughput is not answer latency. Genuine 2h/8h runs still required.

results.scope: Paper result; H100 throughput reported separately.

benchmarks.name: OmniVideoBench
benchmarks.existing: Joint audio/visual questions with reasoning annotations.
benchmarks.gamst: Check that compact context retains information from both modalities.
benchmarks.prepare: Request HF access; preserve original audio, QA and timestamps.
benchmarks.limitations: Research-only access conditions; official offline QA does not establish causal real-time latency. No verified score imported.

benchmarks.name: VSAS-Bench
benchmarks.existing: Synchronous/asynchronous protocols with dense temporal annotations.
benchmarks.gamst: Use asynchronous evaluation principles to test stale answers under load.
benchmarks.prepare: Track official code/data release before integrating.
benchmarks.limitations: Announced apple/ml-vsas-bench URL returned 404 at review; research reference only.

arms.name: Matched VLM baseline
arms.role: Full visual baseline using the same VLM checkpoint, memory and consumer as the hybrid.

arms.name: Gamst + LLM
arms.role: Test how much useful evidence survives without semantic VLM calls.

arms.name: Gamst + VLM + LLM
arms.role: Test quality preservation with selective semantic inspection.

arms.name: Periodic VLM + LLM
arms.role: Control for whether selection beats a fixed inference schedule.

arms.name: Streaming small VLM + LLM
arms.role: Strongest cheap alternative (StreamingVLM-style): a lightweight VLM watching continuously. Gamst must match it on cost and beat it on grounded quality.

arms.name: Published native method
arms.role: Reproduce ProactiveFrame, Ctrl-SPOT or other native baselines under their own protocols.

requirements: Pin and review the Gamst release and installed plugin revisions.
Pass real sensor/provider integration and deletion/revision tests.
Connect authorized GCP account; verify project ID, billing, GPU quota and VM.
Approve dataset access and freeze official revisions and held-out manifest.
Validate native benchmark adapters and continuous multi-query sessions.
Freeze checkpoints, precision, consumer prompt, budgets and full accounting.
Run paired real inference, independent scoring and session-cluster uncertainty.
